title: Arrianus
summary: Raleigh names Arrianus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Arrianus, who from the report of Ptolomie writes of Dragons, and who numbers the Armie at Arbela. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter II, §. VII, sig. 473b
